hero.headline: Break the Code. Own the License.
hero.description: A hands-on crackme competition using fully authorized software targets. Analyze protections, write patches, and build keygens — all legally, all in a sandboxed lab.

categories.name: License Analysis
categories.description: Analyze license key validation algorithms and protection schemes.

schedule.event: Opening stream — walkthrough of rules & tools

faq.q: Are the software targets legal to crack?
faq.a: Yes. Every target is purpose-built crackme software or software provided explicitly for this event under license. Cracking real commercial software is not part of this competition.
Any tool is allowed: IDA Pro, Ghidra, x64dbg, Cheat Engine, Binary Ninja, etc. The lab machine has a standard toolkit pre-installed.
Flags are in CRACK{...} format. Each crackme reveals the flag when successfully cracked or patched.

faq.q: Can I share my patches after the event?
faq.a: Yes — after the event ends, writeups and patches are encouraged to be shared publicly for learning purposes.

lab.title: Lab Targets
lab.subtitle: Authorized crackme binaries
lab.description: All targets below are purpose-built or explicitly licensed for this competition. Do not attempt to crack software outside this list. Flags are in CRACK{...} format.

questions.title: SimpleSerial.exe
questions.description: A Windows x86 application protected by a simple serial number check. Enter the correct serial to reveal the flag. No obfuscation.
questions.hint: Set a breakpoint on common string comparison functions. Look for the comparison between your input and the expected value.

questions.title: PatchMe.exe
questions.description: The application shows 'License Expired' on launch. Patch the binary so it always passes the license date check.
questions.hint: Find the conditional jump after the date comparison and change its direction.

questions.title: KeygenMe.exe
questions.description: Reverse the registration algorithm and write a keygen that produces a valid serial for any given username. Submit a valid serial for the username 'CrackingDay2026'.

allowed: Use any reverse engineering tool (Ghidra, IDA, x64dbg, Binary Ninja, etc.)
Patch binaries using hex editors or patching tools
Use dynamic analysis — debuggers, tracers, API monitors
Search online for general techniques and documentation
not_allowed: Crack or tamper with software outside the provided target list
Share flags, patches, or keygens with other teams during the event
Distribute cracked versions of any software publicly
